title: GEDI Biomass Product Development
description: Development and validation of allometric models underpinning NASA's Global Ecosystem Dynamics Investigation (GEDI) footprint-level aboveground biomass density product (GEDI04_A). GEDI is mounted on the International Space Station and collects full-waveform lidar data across tropical and temperate forests globally.
people: Duncanson · Tang · Liang + GEDI Science Team

title: Protected Areas Carbon Assessment
description: First global-scale quantification of the climate value of protected areas using GEDI data. Results showed that protected forests hold significantly higher biomass stocks than comparable unprotected land — providing empirical evidence for nature-based climate solutions at policy-relevant scales.

title: Charcoal Degradation — Mozambique
description: Combining GEDI LiDAR and Landsat time series to quantify aboveground biomass loss from charcoal production across Mozambique — revealing the invisible carbon footprint of forest degradation in data-scarce regions of sub-Saharan Africa.

title: Boreal Forest Biomass — ICESat-2
description: Developing algorithms for mapping boreal forest structure using NASA's ICESat-2 laser altimeter — extending global lidar biomass mapping into high-latitude forests that are sensitive to climate change and difficult to monitor with optical sensors alone.

title: Forest Biodiversity & Structure Links
description: Testing ecological theory by exploring linkages between forest 3-D structural diversity and biodiversity across global protected areas. Remote sensing data enable tests of ecological hypotheses at unprecedented spatial extent, informing conservation prioritization.

title: CEOS Biomass Product Validation
description: Co-leading the Committee on Earth Observation Satellites (CEOS) Land Product Validation Biomass sub-group — developing consistent international protocols for calibration and validation of global biomass products from multiple satellite missions.
